All green. Summary of the change:

**New `src/utils/aws/scraperRole.ts`**
- `assumeScraperRole` – resolves `fromTemporaryCredentials` (i.e. performs `sts:AssumeRole`) with the supplied `ExternalId`; any failure becomes a `BadRequestException` mentioning the IAM role/external id.
- `validateScraperRoleAccess` – after a successful assume, uses the *returned* credentials to read the instance inventory collection depends on (`getInstanceWithFilters` → `ec2:DescribeInstances`, same call the collection microservices make); failure becomes a `BadRequestException`.
- `isDisconnectIamRole` (blank/whitespace role = disconnect) and `isMissingIamRole` (no role named = invalid) helpers plus shared messages.

**`src/setting/dto/cloudIAMAuthorizer.ts` (new)** – async class-validator constraint `@UsableScraperRole()` applied to `CloudIAM.iamRoleArn`, so requests are rejected by the global `ValidationPipe` with a 400 and an array message naming the exact reason (unassumable vs. assumable-but-cannot-read). Registered in both settings modules; `iamRoleArn`'s `@IsString` message now says a cloudIAM block must name a role and that an empty role disconnects.

**`src/setting/settings.service.ts`** – `SettingsService.validateCloudIAM` runs *first* in `update()`, before `findAll`, `loadPoints` and scheduler changes: a block with no role throws `BadRequestException`, a blank role is normalized to a disconnect that also clears `externalId`, and any other role must pass both proofs — so a failing check writes nothing at all from that save.

**Tests/fixtures** – added `src/setting/cloudIAMValidation.spec.ts` (16 cases against the local AWS emulator: usable role, external-id-less role, inline-policy role, wrong/missing external id, untrusted role, malformed ARN, assumable-but-unauthorized role, disconnect clearing the external id, block naming no role, saves without cloudIAM, plus ValidationPipe response shape), extended the settings integration spec, and pointed the integration fixtures at roles that actually exist in the emulator.
